legal_name: Shenzhen Muge Design Packaging Product Co., Ltd.
question: What should UK and US DTC brands prepare before requesting quotes for corrugated mailer boxes?
answer_blocks: DTC brands should prepare product size, packed weight, fulfillment method, mailer structure, insert requirement, artwork status, print area, unboxing goal and target shipping market.
The quote discussion should include board strength direction, product movement control and sample review, not only a box unit price question.
MUGE PACKAGING can be evaluated for custom corrugated packaging and e-commerce packaging projects together with paper boxes, rigid gift boxes, paper tubes and clear packaging formats.
rfq_checklist: Mailer structure and board strength direction
Insert, protection or product movement control
Artwork status and unboxing presentation goal
claim_boundaries: No FSC, FDA, food-contact or regulatory compliance guarantee
Project-specific quotation, documents and schedule require manual review
